close_reason: Added #[non_exhaustive] to ClosureHandler<B, C> and a ClosureHandler::new(backend, call_fn) constructor. Updated the doc example and both intra-crate tests to use new(). Swept all 8 extension *-server crates (mail x3 macro arms, chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/sharing/metadata/filenode x1 each) to use the new constructor. cargo build/test/clippy/fmt/doc --all-features all clean. The struct now follows the same forward-compat pattern as BackendSetError — fields can be added without major-bump.
title: ClosureHandler<B, C> has pub fields with no #[non_exhaustive] — every field addition is a breaking change
